source: hand-derived G36 sequence reference from fixture topology plus CDL / Buildings .mo semantics; independent re-derivation
compare_regime: exact G36 Tier-A sequence f64 trace (Value::bit_eq)
input: SupplyFan pressure reset with source-default delTim=600s, samplePeriod=120s: the 360s fan restart releases the TrueDelay at 1080s; requests sampled at 1080..1920s are 5, 3, 2, 0, 0, 4, 4, 4, so the setpoint responds +20 (maxRes-capped) to 140 Pa, +3 to 143, trims at exactly numIgnReq to 131, trims to 119 and 107, then responds +18 to 125, 143 and 161; the fan stop at 1980..2099s spans the 2040s sample instant, so the setpoint is iniSet=120 Pa from 1980s through the re-armed TrueDelay (held 161 Pa at the 2100s restart) and the reset resumes from iniSet at 2820s: +18 to 138 (2820s and 2880s), then a trim to 126 at 3000s
reference_rule: Pinned SupplyFan.mo default variant, nested Generic/TrimAndRespond.mo have_hol=false staPreSetRes.y: iniSet=120 Pa until TrueDelay(delTim+samplePeriod) elapses, then UnitDelay(y_start=iniSet) + net reset (triAmo=-12, resAmo=15, maxRes=32, numIgnReq=2) clamped to minSet=25..maxSet=410 Pa every samplePeriod; swi2 feeds iniSet into the UnitDelay while the fan is off
diverges_from_g36_intent: embeds Generic/TrimAndRespond.mo as staPreSetRes (duct static pressure reset); the pressure setpoint and the fan speed it drives are faithful to the pinned Generic/TrimAndRespond.mo graph, not its documentation: the documentation says the setpoint is iniSet while the device is off and the reset starts delTim after device start, but iniSet reaches the reset only through swi2 -> uniDel.u, and the UnitDelay captures it only at a samplePeriod instant. A device-off window that holds no sample instant never reseeds the UnitDelay, so after the re-armed TrueDelay the reset resumes from the stale pre-trip value, not from iniSet. Not a G36-intent answer key for short device trips. supply_fan_status does not depend on the reset; it carries this note because the label is per scenario
format: Modelica CombiTimeTable CSV (_spec/07 §9); signal CSV is time+one output; reference.csv is time+inputs+all outputs; ryu shortest-round-trip f64
